# Default pull request template for asr-eval-toolkit

## Description

<!-- A clear and concise description of what this PR does. -->

## Type of change

<!-- Delete irrelevant options. -->

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New scoring metric (well documented, tested, dependency-free)
- [ ] Documentation improvement
- [ ] CLI improvement
- [ ] CI/CD improvement
- [ ] Breaking change (requires major version bump)

## Motivation

<!-- Explain the problem you're solving, not just what you built. -->

## Testing

<!-- Describe how you tested this change. -->

- [ ] `pytest` passes
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes
- [ ] `ruff format --check .` passes
- [ ] `mypy asr_eval_toolkit` passes (if type annotations changed)
- [ ] Coverage does not decrease
- [ ] Manual testing performed (describe below)

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are limited in scope and purpose
- [ ] No third-party dependencies added (stdlib-only constraint)
- [ ] Public functions have docstrings
- [ ] Tests cover new functionality
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)
